comparison.objective: Commission a robot-axis damper versus safely remove a hot pan after extending an oven rack.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine tool manipulation and iterative mechanism tuning versus articulated rack pulling and protected object transport.
comparison.success_condition: Physical unlock-adjust-lock sequence and safe repeated stops versus rack-first removal without reaching into the oven. The record supplies no specs or detailed safety thresholds.
comparison.reason: The record tests safe access sequencing and transport, not adjustment and energy-absorption behavior.
